name: DataFeedConnection
description: Contains the data and functionality needed to connect to data feeds. The same object is used for all Data Feed types.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified DataFeedConnection object. Read-only.

properties.name: AlwaysUseConnectionFile
properties.description: True if the connection file is always used to establish a connection to the data source. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: CommandText
properties.description: Returns or sets the command string for the specified data source. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: CommandType
properties.description: Returns or sets the command string for the specified data source. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: Connection
properties.description: Returns or sets a string that contains Service Contract settings that enable Microsoft Excel to connect to a Data Feed data source. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: EnableRefresh
properties.description: True if the connection can be refreshed by the user. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: RefreshDate
properties.description: Returns the date on which the OLE DB connection was last refreshed. Read-only Date.

properties.name: Refreshing
properties.description: True if an OLE DB query is in progress for the specified data source connection. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: RefreshOnFileOpen
properties.description: True if the connection is automatically updated each time the workbook is opened. The default value is False.

properties.name: RefreshPeriod
properties.description: Returns or sets the number of minutes between refreshes. Read/write Long.

properties.name: SavePassword
properties.description: True if password information in a data feed connection string is saved in the connection string. False if the password is removed.

properties.name: ServerCredentialsMethod
properties.description: Returns or sets the type of credentials that should be used for server authentication. Read/write XlCredentialsMethod enumeration.

properties.name: SourceConnectionFile
properties.description: Returns or sets a String indicating the Microsoft Office Data Connection file or similar file that was used to create the connection. Read/write.

properties.name: SourceDataFile
properties.description: A path to the original file used to create the connection. In the case of an OData connection, this is the location of the .atom or .atomsvc file used to create the connection. Read/write String.

methods.name: CancelRefresh
methods.description: Cancels a refresh operation on a data feed connection.

methods.name: SaveAsODC
methods.signature: SaveAsODC(ODCFileName As String, [Description As Variant], [Keywords As Variant])
methods.description: Saves the data feed connection as a Microsoft Office Data Connection file.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: Description that will be saved in the file.

parameters.name: Keywords
parameters.description: Space-separated keywords that can be used to search for this file.
